inner_diameter = 65.0
thickness = 15.0
groove_width = 5.0
groove_depth = 3.0
chamfer_size = 1.0
mount_hole_diameter = 5.0
mount_hole_radius = 30.0

            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (0, outer_radius))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (0, inner_radius))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

solid_body = p.part

groove_cyl = Pos(thickness / 2.0, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(inner_radius - groove_depth, groove_width)

top_edges = top_face.edges()
solid_body = chamfer(top_edges, chamfer_size)

part = solid_body
